versions.content: Viability Period of Life Cycle Info The viability of LifeCycle- Info can be restricted for a specific period of time by periodBegin respectively periodEnd . The following items apply: • If no periodBegin is provided then defaultPeriodBegin applies. • If no periodEnd is provided then defaultPeriodEnd applies. • If also no defaultPeriodBegin respectively defaultPeriodEnd is specified then the period is unlimited (e.g. from 2013-01-01 until forever). • Begin and End are considered to be included in the period. Thus at a given point in time t the definitions of LifeCycleInfo is viable if periodBegin < = t < = periodEnd
